description: This file defines a Java interface named ResultList that extends the List interface to include pagination support and metadata about the last result, specifically for search result handling.

classes.name: ResultList
classes.description: A generic interface extending List with additional methods for pagination and retrieving sort values of the last result.

methods.name: nextPageOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset of the next page, or NO_NEXT_PAGE if there is no subsequent page.

methods.name: lastResultSortValues
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the JsonArray of sort expressions of the last result, or empty if not available.
